Definition: to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally
BiblicalUsage: 1) to have a bad smell, stink, smell bad; 1a) (Qal) to stink, smell bad; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to become odious; 1b2) to make oneself odious; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to stink, emit a stinking odour; 1c2) to cause to stink; 1c3) of wickedness (fig.); 1d) (Hithpael) to make oneself odious; 2) (TWOT) to abhor
